recipes.label: A Cornered Beast's Struggle
recipes.startdescription:
This place has been sealed by the sheer malice of the Hours of the Knot. I must either turn and face the fight, or patiently await a chance to escape.

[While the 'Seal of the Triple Knot' remains active, you will be unable to leave the current area.]

recipes.label: Set Out, Through the Borderlands
recipes.startdescription:
Within this city of Britain lies what I need—unfortunately, I must traverse the war-scarred borderlands to reach it.

[Accumulate two Progress in the wilderness to reach your destination. You cannot return here, and local allies and opportunities will be lost.]

recipes.label: Set Out, Through the Bounds
recipes.startdescription:
I will not risk long-distance travel in the physical world—a traveling immortal offers far too many opportunities to attract unwanted attention. And the realm of dreams is no longer friendly, so I choose to move along the border between reality and slumber. Though desolate, chaotic, and fraught with unpredictable dangers, it is the path I take.

[Accumulate three Progress in the wilderness to reach your destination. You cannot return here, and local allies and opportunities will be lost.]
